nodes.title: Can the benchmark be reproduced?
nodes.summary: Reproduce RF-Score and independently check the assumptions behind LP-PDBBind. The project distinguishes confirmed findings, discrepancies, and open hypotheses.

nodes.title: Freeze the internal baseline
nodes.summary: Three fixed 100-tree forests used 7,393 noncovalent training complexes and a training-only 36-feature mask. Settings and seeds were frozen before test reporting; no test-based model selection was performed.

nodes.title: Internal test evaluation
nodes.summary: Test RMSE was 1.5516 ± 0.0075 p-affinity, or 2.1167 ± 0.0102 kcal/mol on the project's comparison scale, versus 2.10 ± 0.003 reported in the journal. Similar means do not establish exact reproduction: settings, conversion, sample provenance, and SD convention remain uncertain.

nodes.title: Evaluate on BDB2020+
nodes.summary: The frozen models were evaluated on 115 records without refitting or seed selection. RMSE was 1.2088 ± 0.0206 p-affinity, or 1.6491 ± 0.0282 kcal/mol on the project scale, versus 1.61 ± 0.008 in the journal; the cause of the difference is unknown.

nodes.title: Resolve remaining uncertainties
nodes.summary: The authors' exact settings and conversion remain unconfirmed. Similarity overlap, assay provenance, historical membership, and coordinate preparation require further investigation.
